name: eng-2176
title: Escape regex metacharacters in discourse node format expressions

prepare.why: the extension has a local database session for this graph, since the local create-space edge function is down
a Draft Claim node type whose format has parentheses, which are regex metacharacters
a page in the Draft Claim format, a look-alike title without the parentheses, and a scratch page

apply.js: (async () => { await proof.page.ensure('Claim (draft) - Sleep improves memory consolidation', ['A Draft Claim page.']); await proof.page.ensure('Claim draft - Naps replace a night of sleep', ['Not a Draft Claim: no parentheses.']); await proof.page.recreate('PK format search scratch', ['']); })()

cases.title: A format with parentheses matches its own titles
cases.caption: The Draft Claim format is Claim, then draft in parentheses, then the content. A page in that format is now recognized as a Draft Claim, so it gets its discourse context.

steps.why: wait for the discourse context under the title

expect.js: (() => { const uid = proof.uid('Claim (draft) - Sleep improves memory consolidation'); proof.assert(window.roamjs.extension.queryBuilder.isDiscourseNode(uid), 'The page is not recognized as a discourse node.'); })()

cases.title: A title without the parentheses is not a Draft Claim
cases.caption: The parentheses are literal text now. A look-alike title without them is a plain page, where the old pattern treated them as a group and matched it.

with.title: Claim draft - Naps replace a night of sleep

expect.js: (async () => { await proof.sleep(800); const uid = proof.uid('Claim draft - Naps replace a night of sleep'); proof.assert(!window.roamjs.extension.queryBuilder.isDiscourseNode(uid), 'The look-alike title matched the Draft Claim format.'); proof.assert(!document.querySelector('.discourse-graph-title-additions'), 'The look-alike page shows a discourse context.'); })()

cases.title: Node search lists the page under Draft Claim
cases.caption: Search finds it too: the node summoning menu lists the page under Draft Claim.

steps.why: search for the Draft Claim page

expect.js: proof.waitFor(() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.discourse-node-search-menu .h-64 > div')).some((section) => { const header = section.querySelector('.border-b'); return header && header.innerText.trim() === 'Draft Claim' && section.innerText.includes('Sleep improves memory consolidation'); }), { what: 'the page listed under Draft Claim' })
